sections.title: Drive Your Career Forward
sections.label: Careers at I-CAR
sections.sublabel: In a culture fueled by collaboration and growth.
body: No matter where you are in your career, from an intern or recent graduate to a seasoned professional or experienced collision repair expert, working at I-CAR is a rewarding step forward. We offer a primarily remote, flexible workplace that supports work-life balance while enabling meaningful collaboration across our teams.

With an award-winning culture and a strong commitment to employee growth and development, I-CAR is a place where people are supported, valued, and empowered to do their best work. Put your talents to use making a lasting impact across an industry that truly matters.

image.alt: Two coworkers walking and talking in an office

sections.title: At I-CAR, You’re In The Driver’s Seat

cards.title: Work That Works For You
cards.body: We offer flexible ways of working that support balance and help you manage personal and professional priorities. While arrangements vary by role, flexibility is a core part of how we work.

image.alt: Remote employee attending a team meeting on his laptop

cards.title: Drive Meaningful Impact
cards.body: Every role at I-CAR contributes to work that helps save lives. By advancing safe, high-quality vehicle repairs, our teams make a real impact across the industry and in every community we serve.

image.alt: Woman securing her child in a carseat

cards.title: A Place Where You Belong
cards.body: We’re committed to creating an inclusive, welcoming environment where everyone feels supported, respected, and valued. Our culture is built on trust, collaboration, and continuous learning, empowering people to grow and thrive at every stage of their careers.

image.alt: Woman attending a virtual team meeting on her computer

sections.title: Find Your Career Path
sections.cardColumnClass: col col-12 col-md-6 col-xl-3 pt-3 mt-3
body: We offer opportunities for people at every stage of their careers and across a wide range of backgrounds. From early career and internships to experienced and technical roles, you’ll find opportunities that match your skills and goals.

cards.title: Early Career Opportunities
cards.body: Start your career with hands-on experience, meaningful work, and opportunities to learn and grow. Build a strong foundation while contributing to a mission-driven organization.

image.alt: Two employees laughing during an office meeting

cards.title: Experienced Professionals
cards.body: Bring your expertise to a collaborative environment where you can lead, innovate, and make an impact. Experienced professionals help drive our operations, growth, and continued success.

image.alt: Employee contemplating his thoughts during a meeting

cards.title: Technical & Industry Roles
cards.body: Use your technical expertise to advance safe, high-quality vehicle repairs. These roles support collision repair, emerging technologies, and industry training, helping raise standards across the field.

image.alt: I-CAR instructor teaching students about safety equipment

cards.title: Internships
cards.body: Gain hands-on experience, develop your skills, and contribute to meaningful work. Our internship programs offer flexible schedules to support academic commitments, with potential for future opportunities based on performance and business needs.

image.alt: Manager pointing to a computer screen while helping an intern

sections.title: Our Hiring Process
body: Our interview process is a two-way conversation focused on meaningful dialogue. While you learn about I-CAR, we’ll get to know your skills, experiences, and accomplishments. We value diverse perspectives and encourage you to bring your authentic self to each conversation.
sections.textColumnClass: col col-12 col-md mt-2 pt-1 mt-md-0 pt-md-0 order-last order-md-first pr-lg-5

image.alt: Professional woman answering a question during an interview

sections.title: A Workplace Built for You
body: At I-CAR, a positive employee experience is at the heart of everything we do. We build trust, collaboration, and leadership through continuous learning and growth, creating an environment where people feel supported, engaged, and empowered to do their best work.

Grounded in integrity and collaboration, our award-winning culture connects us and drives our commitment to excellence across the automotive collision repair industry. We continually listen, learn, and evolve to support our teams, promote work-life balance, and invest in professional growth.
We value diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and talents, and it’s no surprise that most team members are proud to work at I-CAR.
sections.textColumnClass: col col-12 col-md mt-2 pt-1 mt-md-0 pt-md-0 order-last

image.alt: Two images showing both in-person and virtual work environments

sections.title: Recognized for Our Culture
body: I-CAR’s culture is consistently recognized by leading workplace organizations. We’re honored to be named one of the Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces in North America for 2025, ranking #16 overall and #4 among mid-sized companies.

We’ve also been recognized as a Top Workplace and a Great Place to Work®, with additional honors for remote work, compensation and benefits, leadership, purpose and values, and work-life flexibility. These recognitions reflect what our team members experience every day, feeling supported, valued, and connected to meaningful work.
sections.textColumnClass: col col-12 col-md mb-3 pb-3 mb-md-0 pb-md-0 pr-lg-5

image.alt: Collection of award logos that I-CAR has recieved for culture

sections.title: A Message From Our CEO
quoteHtml: Our many workplace recognitions are especially meaningful because they’re driven by the voices and experiences of our team members. These awards reflect the trust, collaboration, and commitment our people bring to their work every day—and I’m deeply grateful for the way they support one another and our customers.

image.alt: Kyle Thompson

quotes.quote: The culture at I-CAR is respectful, inclusive, and truly supportive. This organization values each person’s contributions and unique perspectives, and I feel empowered to bring my authentic self to work every day. I-CAR’s commitment to developing and supporting its team helps people grow into the best versions of themselves while making a meaningful impact on the collision industry. It’s a culture that empowers you to grow, contribute, and be part of something that truly matters.
quotes.name: Olivia Peterson
quotes.title: Instructor Trainee, Specialty Training

image.alt: Olivia Peterson

quotes.quote: Returning to I-CAR in 2026 as a full-time instructor, I quickly recognized its strong commitment to continuous learning and skill development. In my role, I help reinforce the importance of safe, high-quality repairs while supporting learner growth. What stands out most is the culture, one where employees continuously develop, collaborate, and contribute to meaningful work that has a real impact on the industry.
quotes.name: John Spoto
quotes.title: Full-Time Instructor

image.alt: John Spoto

quotes.quote: I-CAR is a place where hard work, sincerity, and empathy are recognized and appreciated every day. The culture fosters a genuine sense of belonging, where people support each other’s success. I’m proud to be part of a team where leaders truly champion our growth, making every contribution feel seen, valued, and impactful. It’s the kind of environment where you can grow, contribute, and feel truly connected to the work you do.
quotes.name: Vathsala Devarjan
quotes.title: Manager, IT Application Agile

image.alt: Vathsala Devarjan

quotes.quote: Since joining I-CAR, I quickly realized it’s more than just an organization—it’s a true community. The collaboration, passion for the industry, and focus on safe, complete, high-quality repairs immediately stood out to me. At its core, I-CAR is committed to helping keep people safe on the road, which makes the work we do even more meaningful. It’s incredibly rewarding to be part of an organization that not only supports its people but also helps elevate standards across the entire collision industry.

sections.title: Employee Benefits
body: We invest in our team member through benefits designed to support overall wellbeing, financial security and balance—so people can do their best work and thrive both professionally and personally.
We believe when people are supported, they succeed—and so does our organization.

sections.title: Benefits That Support You
body: I-CAR offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you and your family at every stage of life. From health and well-being to financial security and career growth, our programs are built to help you thrive—at work and beyond.

cards.title: Time Off
cards.body: Generous paid time off and company holidays

cards.title: Health Benefits
cards.body: Medical, dental, vision, FSA & HSA with employer contribution

cards.title: Career Development
cards.body: Self-study, leadership development and tuition assistance

cards.title: Life Insurance
cards.body: Basic life insurance policy and group discounts

cards.title: Voluntary Benefits
cards.body: Additional protection like identity and pet insurance

cards.title: I-CARe Wellbeing Program
cards.body: Up to $1,000 annually for physical and emotional wellbeing expenses

sections.title: What Our Employees Say About Our Benefits

quotes.quote: Since its introduction, the I-CARe Wellbeing Program has continued to grow in meaningful ways. The flexibility of the cash incentive has made a real difference for me—it allowed my family to invest in home gym equipment that fits perfectly with our busy life of kids and sports. Having the ability to prioritize both physical health and quality time at home has been invaluable. It’s a benefit that truly supports overall wellbeing in a practical and personalized way.
quotes.name: Tony Guzman
quotes.title: Supervisor, Instructional Design

image.alt: Tony Guzman

quotes.quote: I-CAR has been deeply committed to my professional development, providing meaningful leadership opportunities that have helped advance my career. As I’ve progressed and started a family, the support and flexibility I’ve received in balancing work and home life have made a lasting impact. I-CAR has a unique culture that truly enables growth—both professionally and personally—in a way that feels sustainable and supported.
quotes.name: Johnathan Pettinato
quotes.title: Director, People & Culture

image.alt: Johnathan Pettinato

quotes.quote: Having comprehensive medical benefits meant the hardest part of my experience was simply hearing the diagnosis. Meritian Health made everything after that feel manageable, guiding me through each step with clarity and compassion so I could focus on healing instead of navigating complexity. The support I received gave me confidence and peace of mind during a challenging time, showing how much I-CAR truly cares about its people.
quotes.name: Sonja Bristow
quotes.title: Manager, Delivery Enablement (Northeast)

image.alt: Sonja Bristow

quotes.quote: At I-CAR, I work with people I genuinely enjoy every day. There’s a strong sense of teamwork, support, and shared purpose that makes the work both meaningful and rewarding. I’ve been trusted to take on new challenges and grow over time. I-CAR also gives me the flexibility to be present for my three kids and their activities, which makes a real difference in my life.
